A SMALL REHEARSAL FOR KOREA

Privacy & your practice data

Version date: October 2, 2026 · Operator: Jeremy (제레미)

The practice game does not ask for an account, payment information, recordings, or personal details.

Browser storage

We use localStorage for two settings: menunori-language stores English or Korean, and menunori-completed stores the numbers of missions you completed. These settings remain in this browser until you clear them. Your practice basket is held in page memory and is discarded when you reload.

This app does not send your mission results or basket to a MenuNori database. Other people using the same browser profile can see its saved preferences and progress.

Clear your preferences and progress

This clears only the two MenuNori settings in this browser. You can also use your browser’s site-data settings.

Hosting and fonts

The hosting service processes web requests to deliver these pages and may keep technical access information under its own policies. This private preview uses ChatGPT Sites and its access controls. Fonts are requested from Google Fonts; the request can transmit technical information such as your IP address to Google. See Google’s privacy policy.

Advertising and analytics

This version loads no AdSense advertising code and no analytics tracking scripts. If advertising is enabled, this notice will be revised to describe the actual providers, storage and user choices. The current notice does not claim that future advertising is cookie-free.

Links and contact

External links take you to other websites with their own privacy practices. MenuNori’s operator is Jeremy (제레미). A public contact address is still to be added before the advertising launch.
